newsitem.title: USA: Mutual Risk reorganizes captive operations.
newsitem.headline: Mutual Risk reorganizes captive operations.

text.p: Mutual Risk Management Ltd said Monday it has restructured its captive management operations, putting its six independently operated business in that line under an operating unit called Mutual Risk Captive Group.
Captive management operation involve such services as administration and accounting to insurance-related subsidiaries of holding companies that are basically not in the insurance business.

The company said the restructuring covers its captive management operations for subsidiaries incorporated or domiciled in Barbados, Bermuda, Cayman, Dublin and Vermont and its most recently opened operation for Guernsey, Channel Islands.
The company said the move is among the steps it is taking to more aggressively market its captive management services in the U.S. and international markets.
Mutual Risk Management is a $1.6 billion provider of risk-management services to clients seeking alternatives to traditional commercial insurance for certain risks. Monday, 7 April 1997 17:03:17
